subject: Eval gate finalization — MAP lock, signature cadence, and start-date handoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sara Jacobs <sara.j@acme-retail.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Eval gate finalization — MAP lock, signature cadence, and start-date handoff

Hi Sara / Evan,

Thanks again for the productive evaluation sessions last week. Per our MAP, we're at the final stretch and I want to align on a tight, executable close plan so we can meet your July 1 start date without surprises. Attached are: MAP_v3.pdf (final mutual action plan), Evaluation_plan_ACME.xlsx (tests & acceptance gates), and a draft with the negotiated redlines (Redlines_ACME_v2.docx).

High-level ask: please confirm the following by end of day Friday 6/4 so we can circulate an e-sign packet Monday 6/7 and lock the execution window:
- Executive go/no-go (yes/no) for the MAP as-is (MAP_v3.pdf).
- Procurement timing for signature and PO issuance (expected date).
- Final legal exceptions to be limited to the list in Redlines_ACME_v2.docx; anything outside that list will require SLA review with our execs.

Proposed cadence (we're flexible but want clarity):
1) Friday 6/4 — ACME to confirm go/no-go and surface any final legal asks.
2) Monday 6/7 — We send DocuSign envelope for signature routing (ACME legal -> Procurement -> ACME exec).
3) Wednesday 6/9 — Expected fully executed contract (target); Friday 6/11 — contract inked + onboarding kickoff planning.

If any of the dates above are a hard constraint on your side please highlight. We're prepared to accommodate a one-week shift but need the explicit lock to reserve dedicated capacity.

Notes on acceptance gates (see Evaluation_plan_ACME.xlsx):
- Perf gate: 95th pct latency under 180ms for key route during two-hour stress window.
- Quality gate: pass rate >= 92% on the seeded evaluation set.
- Operational gate: prefix caching validated for 30% token savings on sample workload.

Rishi & Laura are on copy to coordinate the DocuSign flow and the onboarding timeline once we have the green light.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps speed alignment.

—
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (17 pages), Evaluation_plan_ACME.xlsx (6 sheets), Redlines_ACME_v2.docx (3 pages)

From: Sara Jacobs <sara.j@acme-retail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@acme-retail.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acme-retail.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval gate finalization — MAP lock, signature cadence, and start-date handoff

Kimberly — thanks for the summary and the attachments. The team reviewed overnight. Two quick items from ACME side: 

1) Procurement timeline: We can confirm routing for signature starting 6/7 but PO issuance will be after signature; expected PO date is 6/14 (procurement requires final countersigned agreement + internal vendor setup).

2) Legal redlines: Evan flagged two items outside of the list in Redlines_ACME_v2.docx around data residency and audit windows. He summarized specifics below and attached a short note (Evan_Redlines_note.pdf).

We can still meet a July 1 service start if the PO arrives by 6/14 and onboarding resources are confirmed. Can you confirm resource hold until 6/14 (we understand this may be a small reservation fee)?

Also, our security team confirmed the operational gate items (prefix caching & perf) look acceptable given the profiling data you shared.

I'll be OOO Friday but Evan/Procurement will respond if anything changes.

-Sara
Sara Jacobs
Head of AI Product
Acme Retail
sara.j@acme-retail.com

Kimberly / team — quick legal note from my review: two narrow asks we need to confirm before countersign: 
1) Data residency: ACME requires EU customer data to be stored in EU-region GPUs when we onboard EU customers. For the initial contract run (US-only) we can accept Redwood's hosted controls but want the clause scoped for regional deployments.
2) Audit logs retention: request 24 months retention for traceable audit logs tied to calls covered under the agreement.

Both of these are operational asks rather than a categorical blocker; we propose a written commitment in the order form and a short SOW addendum (2 paragraphs) rather than reworking the main contract. I attached the note (Evan_Redlines_note.pdf).

If you can accept the addendum approach we can proceed with the signature cadence Sara proposed. If not, we'll need a short call early next week to converge.

Thanks,
Evan Cho
Senior Counsel, Acme Retail
Evan.cho@acme-retail.com

Subject: Re: Eval gate finalization — MAP lock, signature cadence, and start-date handoff

Sara / Evan — thanks for the quick reviews and the redline notes. Confirming Redwood position and next steps so everyone has a single source of truth: 

1) We accept the addendum approach for the two legal asks. We'll add a two-paragraph SOW addendum covering (a) EU-region residency for EU customer data when ACME deploys in EU; and (b) 24-month audit log retention for covered calls. Rishi will draft and circulate the two-paragraph addendum by end of day 6/8.

2) Resource hold: Redwood will hold the onboarding cohort and dedicated capacity reservation through 6/14 without charging an extra fee, provided ACME confirms PO issuance by 6/14. If PO slips past 6/14 we will need to either charge a short-term reservation fee or reschedule the start date.

3) Signature cadence: we'll open the DocuSign envelope on Monday 6/7 and route to: ACME Legal (Evan) -> ACME Procurement -> ACME Exec (Sara). We expect countersign by 6/9 if routing flows smoothly; PO on 6/14 as noted. DocuSign link will be shared from rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com.

4) Acceptance testing: We'll run the two-hour performance window on 6/16 (backup 6/18) to validate the perf gate; quality runs will be seeded from your evaluation set and results posted in the shared sheet. 

Please reply-all with an explicit "ACK" if that summary matches ACME's expectations. Once we get ACK, Rishi will send the DocuSign packet and the addendum.

If you'd prefer a final 20-minute check-in call Monday morning before the envelope goes out, I'm available at 9:00-9:30 PT.

—
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Rishi will attach DocuSign envelope and the SOW addendum (draft) when circulating.
